summary:
Iteration 72 — Live re-test of the NEW auto-straighten feature (area-auto-straighten-toggle, auto-snap-on-determined, 90° quick button, removed 'Alle Ecken rechtwinklig' for new rooms, 8-step RoomCoach, area-status 'Noch N Angabe(n) fehlt/fehlen', Punkte-mode auto-off on long-press). Viewport 768x1024 primarily, phone 390x844 for A10. All seeded via localStorage; no sketches persisted.

LIVE-PASS (7 items):
- A1 Baseline: skewed quad with sides (220,250)→(520,260)→(530,490)→(210,470); measure 4/3/4/3; Mehr → area-angles-toggle ON → area-angle-90-0 → area-angle-0 value='90'; area-status flips exactly to 'Raum eindeutig bestimmt – Fläche 12,00 m². Alle übrigen Winkel und Diagonalen sind berechnet.'; drawing auto-snaps to a 4×3 rectangle (all four corner badges show 90°); area-straighten disabled and reads '\uf344Skizze passt zu den Maßen'. area-right-angles-toggle is NOT rendered (new room). area-auto-straighten-toggle rendered. area-status at 0 angles reads correctly: 'Noch 1 Angabe fehlt: unten „Winkel angeben…". (/tmp/A1_after_90.png)
- A2 Later measurement change: with room determined, change line 0 from 4→5 and line 2 from 4→5; drawing re-snaps automatically to a 5×3 rectangle (15,00 m²). Snap is STABLE after 2.5 s – label (x,y) identical between first read and second read 2.5 s later (no endless loop, no CPU spin, zero PAGEERROR). (/tmp/A2_after_resize.png)
- A3 Toggle OFF: click area-auto-straighten-toggle → localStorage aufmassprofi_auto_straighten='0'. In the same skewed room pressing area-angle-90-0 does NOT move the drawing (label diff pre/post = 0 px on all 4 sides). area-straighten (Skizze geraderücken) is enabled and when tapped manually straightens the room (pre→after diff > 0). After page reload the localStorage value is still '0' – setting survives.
- A7 Triangle 3/4/5: three clicks forming a rough triangle, measure 3/4/5 on the three sides → area-status reads exactly 'Dreieck ist durch die drei Seiten eindeutig bestimmt – Fläche 6,00 m². Winkel: 53,1° / 90° / 36,9°'. warn=false. Auto-straightens within the debounce window. (/tmp/A7.png)
- A8 Undo after auto-straighten: draw skewed quad, measure 4/3/4/3, 90° on corner 0 → rect; sketch-undo-button → labels (x,y) match the recorded skew exactly (distance 0) and do NOT re-snap even after 2.5 s wait (auto-straighten does not fire on undo, confirming autoStraightenKeysRef remembers the previous key). sketch-redo-button restores the rectangle (distance to recorded rect = 0). (/tmp/A8_after_undo_redo.png)
- B1 Practice coach 8-step flow (1→6 verified live): URL ?practice=1 opens coach with 'Übung · Schritt 1 von 8', title 'Raum zeichnen'. After closing the 4-point polygon the counter advances to Schritt 2 'Linie anwählen'. Clicking a line midpoint advances to Schritt 3 'Alle Seiten bemaßen'. Typing 4/3/4/3 advances to Schritt 4 'Eine Ecke verschieben'. Dragging corner 0 by ~20 px advances to Schritt 5 whose title is EXACTLY 'Diagonale eingeben – Skizze rückt gerade'. Entering '5' into the auto-focussed diagonal field via the in-panel numpad (page.get_by_text('5',exact=True).last) triggers auto-straighten AND advances to Schritt 6 'Wandhöhe eintragen' — i.e. step 5 completes only when determined && straight, matching the new spec. Screenshot /tmp/B1_practice_done.png confirms Schritt 6 copy ('Dazu tippst du: Mehr > Wandhöhe'). room-coach-exit button present.
- Removal of area-right-angles-toggle for new rooms: CONFIRMED both in A1 (4-corner new room) and A6 (6-corner new room). Toggle is only conditionally rendered when option.rightAngles is already true (see /app/frontend/src/components/sketch/AreaOptionsSection.tsx:193).
- area-angle-90-<k> button: WORKS. Click writes '90' into area-angle-<k> (observed on k=0 and verified value via DOM read). On the 6-corner L the three convex-corner buttons (k=0,1,3) all set 90° correctly.

PARTIAL / INCONCLUSIVE (3 items):
- A6 Octagon / 6-corner L: area-right-angles-toggle is correctly ABSENT. 90° buttons are present for every corner and set values correctly. However one of the 6 sides could not be reliably clicked (the 1,5 m vertical notch was too close to a corner for the test midpoint heuristic) so area-status stayed at 'Erst alle Seiten bemaßen – dann werden Winkel und Diagonalen berechnet.' – NOT a product bug, test-script limitation. On the 4-corner A1 flow the required missing-count status 'Noch 1 Angabe fehlt: …' is seen; for a 6-corner room the computed status string would be 'Noch 3 Angaben fehlen' per AreaOptionsSection.tsx:147 (code-reviewed, needs a complete 6-sided measurement to exercise live).
- A10 Phone 390×844 repeat of A1: viewport set, canvas rendered 310×500 inside the 390×744 area. Toolbar is horizontally scrollable, line labels readable, 4m/3m/4m/3m displayed, '= 14 lfm • 12,00 m²' overview visible. panel-options-toggle is present on phone. ISSUE: after tapping Mehr the area-options content (area-angles-toggle, area-angle-90-0, area-auto-straighten-toggle) is rendered BELOW the panel header but the panel reserves the lower ~380 px for the number keypad, so the area section is in a thin scrollable strip that requires manual scroll to reach — area-angles-toggle was not reachable via a plain CSS selector click in the limited viewport. This is a UX finding (readable but requires scrolling) — the controls themselves are tappable once in view, and the drawing stays inside the canvas after snap (shiftIntoBounds works). (/tmp/A10_phone.png)
- B1 Steps 6→8 Wandhöhe/Öffnung/Verschieben: step 6 was reached live but then my second click on panel-options-toggle toggled the Mehr panel OFF instead of keeping it open, so wall-section-toggle was hidden when queried. This is a TEST FLOW issue, not an app bug — RoomCoach still reports 'Schritt 6 von 8' with the matching title. Code review of /app/frontend/src/components/sketch/RoomCoach.tsx confirms the 8-step map has step 8 'Tür oder Fenster verschieben' with no chips array, matching the spec. Full 6→8 drive-through needs a measure-panel-close testID to deterministically close the panel between steps (previous iter_71 action item not yet addressed).

LIVE-FAIL / BUG (1 item, PLEASE VERIFY):
- B2 point-move-only auto-off on long-press: BUG REPRO. Drew a clean rectangle (200,250)→(520,250)→(520,490)→(200,490), switched to tool-edit, enabled point-move-only-toggle. Long-press on the right-line midpoint (520,370) with mouse.down→1100 ms→mouse.up produced NO opening-insert menu (opening-insert-window element is null). The expected flow per spec is: long-press on a line, the OpeningInsertMenu appears, tapping opening-insert-window inserts a window AND the point-move-only toggle flips OFF automatically so the new opening can be dragged immediately. Observed: the menu never opened, so the auto-off path could not be exercised. Hypothesis: when pointMoveOnly is ON the editor still routes long-press to the point-only responder (findNearestPolylinePointImpl) and never falls through to the opening-insert gesture. Needs inspection of the gesture arbiter in /app/frontend/app/sketches/draw.tsx (search 'pointMoveOnly' and 'longPress' / 'onLongPress'). As a control: in iter_71 the same long-press-on-line at 520x490 worked when pointMoveOnly was OFF, so the long-press pipeline itself is healthy. Test files: /tmp/B2_opening.png shows no OpeningInsertMenu after the 1100 ms hold.

NOT-EXECUTED (4 items, ran out of iteration budget):
- A4 Photo exception: not seeded live. CODE-ONLY verified at /app/frontend/app/sketches/draw.tsx:793 — `const onPhoto = !!backgroundImage || elements.some(el => el.type === 'image');` and the early-return at line 800 `if (previous === undefined || previous === key || !autoStraighten || onPhoto) return el;` guarantees auto-straighten is skipped when any image element is in the sketch (and also skipped on first-see for a freshly loaded sketch – the `previous === undefined` branch covers A5 'no snap on load').
- A5 Old sketch load: CODE-ONLY. The `previous === undefined` branch (draw.tsx:800) means on the very first effect run after load autoStraightenKeysRef has no entry, so the loaded skewed shape is just remembered and not straightened. Live verification would need a sketch-save flow driven through the check icon, then reopen via ?sketchId=<id> — recommend main agent runs this manually.
- A9 Openings stay on their line with correct offsets after auto-straighten: NOT-EXECUTED.
- B3 Legacy rightAngles=true sketches: NOT-EXECUTED (requires seeding a saved sketch with polygonAreaOptions[<id>].rightAngles=true in aufmassprofi_sketches storage).

Zero PAGEERROR and zero console[error] across the whole session.

ui_bugs.issue: B2 LIVE-FAIL: with point-move-only-toggle ENABLED, a long-press on a line midpoint does NOT open the OpeningInsertMenu — opening-insert-window / opening-insert-door are not rendered. Expected per spec: long-press on a line should still trigger the opening menu AND auto-switch point-move-only OFF so the new opening is draggable immediately. Reproduction: route /sketches/draw?projectId=p1 → tool-polygon draw a 200x200 rectangle → tool-edit → click point-move-only-toggle (ON) → mouse.move(520_mid, 370_mid) mouse.down wait(1100ms) mouse.up → check [data-testid=opening-insert-window] → null. Control: same long-press with point-move-only OFF opens the menu (verified in iter_71 O1). Suspected file: /app/frontend/app/sketches/draw.tsx (gesture routing). See /tmp/B2_opening.png.

A10 UX: after tapping Mehr the area-options list (area-auto-straighten-toggle, area-angles-toggle, area-angle-90-k, area-diagonals-toggle, area-straighten) renders in a narrow scrollable strip above the docked number keypad; on 390x844 only ~160 px of vertical room is left for that strip, so the area controls need manual scroll to reach. Either auto-collapse the keypad when Mehr is tapped, or give the area section a larger max-height / allow collapsing the keypad via panel-keyboard-toggle more discoverably. File: /app/frontend/src/components/sketch/draw/MeasurePanelOptions.tsx. See /tmp/A10_phone.png.

issues: Mehr-section is cramped under docked keypad; swap or auto-collapse keypad when Mehr is toggled to improve one-hand reachability.

action_items: (HIGH) Verify B2 bug in /app/frontend/app/sketches/draw.tsx long-press gesture routing: when pointMoveOnly is true, long-press on a line midpoint currently seems to be swallowed by the point-only responder. The new auto-off behaviour requires the opening gesture to still fire so the toggle can be flipped off. Grep for 'pointMoveOnly', 'onLongPress', 'onResponderStart', 'LongPressGestureHandler' — likely the long-press detector is gated behind a tool-mode check that returns early when pointMoveOnly is ON. Add a test: with pointMoveOnly=true, a mouse-down on a line segment held >700 ms must still emit the OpeningInsertMenu.

(MEDIUM) Improve mobile UX of the Mehr/area-options strip in /app/frontend/src/components/sketch/draw/MeasurePanelOptions.tsx: when the keypad is docked and viewport height < 900, either auto-collapse the keypad on Mehr tap or give the scrollable options area at least 240 px.

(MEDIUM — carry-over from iter_71) Add testIDs: measure-panel-close, measure-panel-mehr-close (so panel-options-toggle has a deterministic OPEN/CLOSED semantic), diagonal-input, wall-height-input-all (new runs still can't reliably drive 6→8 in the practice coach).

(LOW) A4 photo exception, A5 old-sketch load, A9 openings-after-snap, B3 legacy rightAngles are code-reviewed to be correct but were not driven live; retest when a saved-sketch seeding path with explicit polygon JSON + image element is available (keys: aufmassprofi_sketches list; sketch_meta_<id>, sketch_img_<id>_<elementId>).
critical_code_review_comments: Auto-straighten effect at /app/frontend/app/sketches/draw.tsx:788-810 looks correct: 500 ms debounce, per-element keyMap (autoStraightenKeysRef), early-return on `previous === undefined` (no snap on load), `!autoStraighten` (toggle OFF), and `onPhoto` (image element present). Depends only on [lineSegmentMeasurements, polygonAreaOptions] — a point-drag does NOT retrigger it, which is what lets undo restore the skew without re-snapping. ✓

AreaOptionsSection.tsx:147 'missing(count)' generates 'Noch 1 Angabe fehlt' / 'Noch N Angaben fehlen' and adjusts the tail with/without 'und die Skizze rückt sich gerade' depending on autoStraighten. Confirmed live at 0-angle state of A1. ✓
AreaOptionsSection.tsx:193 renders area-right-angles-toggle ONLY when `n >= 4 && rightAngles` — confirmed ABSENT in A1 and A6 (new rooms). ✓
AreaOptionsSection.tsx:202-209 adds the testID=area-angle-90-<k> button next to every angle field and writes '90' into the corresponding angle slot via withOrder — confirmed LIVE in A1 and A6. ✓

success_rate.frontend: LIVE-PASS 7 (A1, A2, A3, A7, A8, B1 1→6, removed right-angles-toggle) / LIVE-FAIL 1 (B2 long-press+pointMode) / PARTIAL 3 (A6, A10, B1 6→8) / CODE-ONLY 4 (A4, A5, A9, B3). 0 PAGEERROR, 0 console[error].

No sketches persisted to aufmassprofi_sketches. User's real data untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pick up at B2 (point-move-only auto-off): confirm the bug is in the long-press arbiter — with point-move-only toggled ON, long-press on a line must still open OpeningInsertMenu (and then flip the toggle OFF automatically). Reproducer in body above. Then drive A5 (seed a saved sketch), A9 (openings after snap), B3 (legacy rightAngles seed). For B1 6→8, need measure-panel-close testID to close the measure panel between coach steps deterministically; without it the main-agent-request to 'drive the wall-section-toggle after Schritt 6' hits the same race condition as iter_71. Verified-good coords @ 768x1024: canvas box x=0 y=192 w=768 h=904, skewed-quad pts (220,250)(520,260)(530,490)(210,470), midpoints top(370,255) right(525,375) bottom(370,480) left(215,370). On 390x844 the canvas box is x=0 y=136 w=390 h=744.
rca_of_issue: B2 RCA: /app/frontend/app/sketches/draw.tsx has a long-press / point-move gesture arbiter that currently prioritises point-move when pointMoveOnly is true. The new spec requires long-press on a LINE segment (not a corner) to still open the OpeningInsertMenu even when pointMoveOnly is ON, and the opening-insert path should then flip point-move-only OFF. Suggested fix path: in the gesture detector keep the point-only short-circuit only when the grabbed location is near a polyline VERTEX (hit via findNearestPolylinePoint), and fall through to the normal long-press pipeline when the hit is on a LINE MIDPOINT. Then, in the opening-insert handler, call setPointMoveOnly(false) as the first line (AsyncStorage key already auto-flushes). Reproduce: described above; expected: opening-insert-window present within 1200 ms of mouse-down on the line midpoint, and immediately draggable.
